p-drakes-9524754809045.d:
The chore jacket’s older sibling, the work coat traces its roots to early 20th-century workwear, shaped by the demands of the Industrial Revolution.
Cut from a soft Italian suede that will relax and deepen with wear, taking on the patina of a well-used favourite rather than something overly precious, while riveted denim-style buttons replace the usual horn, a subtle nod to classic Americana and workwear traditions. The silhouette is deliberately boxy and relaxed, borrowing from the straightforward proportions of factory coats and workshop jackets, designed to layer easily and move without fuss.
Three patch pockets at the hip, plus an additional tool pocket on the chest, provide generous storage and nod to traditional atelier and studio garb, while raglan sleeves and a cotton-cupro sleeve lining bring a quietly sartorial note.
The result is a working coat in spirit, but one that sits just as comfortably with tailoring as it does with denim.
• 100% Suede Outer
• Cotton-Cupro Sleeve Lining
• Made in Italy
• Triple Hip Patch Pockets
• Raglan Sleeves
• Adjustable Cuffs
• Chest Tool Pocket
• Rivet Buttons

p-drakes-9524756512981.d:
A true staple of the modern wardrobe, the single-breasted jacket forms the foundation of a considered collection. Its clean lines and 3-roll-2 button stance create a sharp, versatile silhouette, perfectly balanced for everyday ease.
Cut in the Drake’s signature silhouette, it features a natural shoulder, subtle waist shaping, and a light construction that allows the jacket to move gracefully with the wearer.
Expertly tailored and fully canvassed with a hand-shaped chest, the jacket drapes naturally over the body, offering both shape and comfort. Hand-attached collars and sleeves provide a flexibility unmatched by machine construction, allowing the jacket to adapt seamlessly to the wearer, while a buggy lining ensures fluidity across the back and shoulders, and traditional lapels, with a wider profile and richer belly, reflect our time-honed house style.
A substantial and variegated Italian corduroy from one of the country’s great specialists, with a soft handle and a rich, tactile wale. The sort of cloth that gets better with wear, developing the lived-in character that makes corduroy such a perennial around here.
